messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 Alert — api.redwood.com returning elevated 5xx (gateway errors). 15% error rate sustained for 3m. Pager: @sam-oncall.
erin: I'm seeing the spike too, started ~10:11 UTC. Latency also up on ingress.
sam-oncall: on it. grabbing traces and envoy stats. tagging @maria and @ben for LB/route config.
maria: I just checked recent LB rollouts — we rolled a route/retry policy change at 09:58 UTC (canary -> global). Noted a retry-on-5xx enabled for the /v1/generate route.
ben: also saw a config tweak: circuit_breakers for backend-service reduced maxpending to 10 in that rollout. suspicious.
erin: logs from edge show a lot of 502/504 from our upstream. example: `curl -i https://api.redwood.com/v1/health -H "Host: api.redwood.com"` -> HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
sam-oncall: grabbing envoy stats snapshot: `cluster.backend-service.5xx: 980`, `cluster.backend-service.success: 5200`, 5xx rate ~16.8% at peak. Opened a quick span: a LOT of retry traffic to same backend leading to overload.
maria: if retries are enabled client-side + LB retries + envoy retries that can cascade. the circuit breakers we pushed are too aggressive (drop to healthy hosts) causing more 5xx.
erin: can we disable the new retry policy on the edge first and see? that would stop amplification.
ben: agree. plan: 1) disable retry policy on edge route, 2) temporarily raise circuit_breakers limits, 3) monitor 5xx. rollback route if needed.
sam-oncall: on it. applying patch to edge config to set `retry_policy: none` for /v1/generate.
deploy-bot: Deploy request accepted: edge-config v2026.03.15-rollback-retries -> applying to cluster edge-us-east (canary fraction 100%).
(2m later)
deploy-bot: edge-config v2026.03.15-rollback-retries applied to edge-us-east (100%).
sam-oncall: disabled retries. watching metrics...
erin: 5xx rate dropped to 6.3% after ~90s. latency still elevated but trending down.
maria: pushing a quick override to circuit_breakers on backend-service: `max_connections: 200`, `max_pending_requests: 100`, `max_requests: 500`. Applying now.
deploy-bot: config-update applied to backend-service clusters.
ben: after both changes, 5xx back to baseline ~0.9% and p95 latency returning to normal. Good signal.
sam-oncall: marking incident mitigated. continuing to monitor for 30m.
erin: quick customer impact note: external telemetry showed ~14% of requests for 10:11–10:14 got 5xx, mainly /v1/generate. Could affect heavy customers and streaming sessions. Support, please surface to impacted accounts.
support-bot: Raised support case summary and started outreach to top 5 impacted customers (IDs attached).
maria: root cause hypothesis: new retry policy rollout + aggressive circuit_breaker tuning caused amplified retries and tripped backends. We underprovisioned circuit_breaker thresholds for the increased retry behavior.
ben: follow-ups: 1) revert retry rollout until we have staged testing, 2) add automatic safety throttle for retries (cap RPS of retried attempts), 3) make circuit_breaker tuning part of the rollout checklist with load testing, 4) add metric alert for retry amplification.
sam-oncall: assigning postmortem to @erin and @maria. I'll add timeline and raw envoy stats.
erin: cool, I'll collect traces, config diffs, and exact deploy IDs.
maria: I'll draft rollback playbook and a canary test that simulates upstream 5xx to validate next retry policy change.
ben: thanks everyone. leaving the thread open for any late regressions. :thumbsup:
